input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic remote monitoring center reported a minor, non-recurrent ventricular tachycardia-adjacent irregularity with no adverse patient outcome recorded. The retrospective clinician note documenting this ventricular tachycardia-adjacent irregularity was never filed, so recurrence cannot yet be ruled out from the record alone. The case is being handled at a monitoring/investigation level, not as a confirmed life-threatening event.

evidence_links.relevance_note: This report confirms the occurrence of a life-threatening complete atrioventricular block event, which is not directly related to this incident but provides context for understanding the severity and handling of similar events.

risk_report.rationale: The incident involved a minor, non-recurrent ventricular tachycardia-adjacent irregularity with no adverse patient outcome recorded. Although the event was handled at a monitoring/investigation level and did not result in any realized harm, it may trigger obligations under EU MDR Annex I, Chapter II, Section 17.4 regarding minimum IT security requirements and Article 83(1)-(2) for post-market surveillance system planning. The static analysis reports from ARTIFACT-STATICANALYSIS-2014A and ARTIFACT-STATICANALYSIS-2018A do not provide specific information related to this incident, so the technical details are insufficient to make a definitive judgment.
